environment.codec_overrides: cleared; CLI --profile selects encode settings; per-row reader_environment selects API settings

note: Negative cost is retained if measured. No threshold is fitted to expected 0.41% or 6.68%.

protocol.query_coordinates: 0-based original-file byte offsets; identical 16384-byte requests for every row
protocol.latency: API-only: bgzf_useek + bgzf_read, ZSTD_seekable_decompress, or aceapex_decompress_region; excludes FASTA processing, return checks, verification, initialization, loading, caller allocation and serialization
protocol.archives: bgzip anonymous Linux memfd, .gzi loaded once; ACEAPEX and zstd malloc buffers
protocol.decoder_state: one initialized handle per codec, reused across warmup and all 200 queries
protocol.amplification: actual decoded chunk bytes / requested bytes; count BGZF block expansion, zstd block expansion inside frames including buffered output, and ACEAPEX chunks in all four streams

amplification_evidence.bgzip: inflate/libdeflate output counters in separate pass
amplification_evidence.zstd: actual decompressed block sizes at streaming and one-shot decode sites in a pinned-source counting copy
amplification_evidence.aceapex: actual selected raw chunk sizes, separately for literals/offsets/lengths/commands, in a pinned-source counting copy

protocol.gpu: n/a: no GPU adapter in stage 1

batch.H_alpha: Shannon entropy of request-start blocks using row block size
batch.hot_set: 64 unique canonical 16 KiB blocks selected once per run; identical raw-byte traces across codecs
batch.method: loop for all codecs; native batch additionally measured for both ACEAPEX profiles

break_even.meaning: derived independent-read intersection; not batch crossover; no plateau throughput claim

configuration.block_note: BGZF uncompressed size ceiling; actual blocks may be shorter

baseline_configuration.caveat: Operational bgzip/gzip comparison: implementations and match search differ; not a pure block-reset ablation.
